decisions.reason: The candidate already identifies J_SENSOR_PWR as the main-to-sensor power connector; the source introduces no new power-interface state.
Naming the sensor-board input connectors does not change I2C speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or cable-length conditioning.
The source specifies connector references and does not modify any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment.
The sensor-board connector statement does not alter native USB data lines or programming behavior.
A same-message MODIFY already records J_SENSOR_PWR and J_SENSOR_SIG as the power and signal input connector references, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
The source concerns the sensor board's two connections from the main board and does not change the separate panel reset connector.
The source is limited to main-to-sensor-board connectivity and does not alter panel button or switch inputs.
The statement describes inputs to the sensor board, not the main board's separate PIR connector.
The source does not change either capacitive-touch connector or its GPIO mapping.
The sensor-board input connector references do not affect LED power, data drive, level shifting, or part selection.
The source concerns connections from the main board to the sensor board and does not change the panel power-button connection on the main board.
The source contains no decision about the passive buzzer's interface, package, voltage, or approved part.
